08guk1a42qdlodrvlub50mugc7: How many steps n takes to reach 1, after `taken`: halved (shifted down one bit) when even, 3n + 1 when odd (the Collatz map). Nobody has proved every n gets there; every n anyone has tried does.
qnqf82i650i1mc5ol21tvjs794: How many steps the numbers take to reach 1, all together: a fold adding each one's steps to the rest's. Each one's steps only compute, so on Node the compiled program works them out for runs of the numbers on worker threads and adds them up, the same sum as in turn (whole numbers add up the same in any order).
g95c26ne1488q4gpk0o1hu9kpv: The most steps any of the numbers takes to reach 1: a fold keeping the larger of each one's steps and the rest's most. Each one's steps only compute, so on Node the compiled program works out the most for runs of the numbers on worker threads, then the most of those: the same as in turn, as the larger of two whole numbers is the same whichever is looked at first.
b79etbptvlgutc3rtt9hd79tbj: The fingerprint of the numbers below `below` (the first argument, 3000 when there is none): a hash of each one's block of walks, in order. Each block is a thousand Collatz walks, so the numbers' work is long while putting the hashes together is quick.
program:
The numbers whose way to 1 under the Collatz map is long, kept by one keep (C43).
Prior art: the Collatz problem (Lothar Collatz, 1937); Lagarias, "The 3x + 1 problem and its generalizations" (1985).
e2tah55b34rn0qv2njg7bvnn5a: A hash of the numbers' blocks of walks, in order: the rest's hash times 31, plus this number's walks, kept to 30 bits. The order counts, so this is no sum: the parts can't be put together in any order. But each number's walks only compute and never read the rest's, so on Node the compiled program works them out for runs of the numbers on worker threads first, as a map would, and then puts the hashes together in turn (C42e).
06tca9i5qr37g5b6f34elc7je7: The steps of some numbers all together, and the most any one of them takes.
0i3gcltgq29i6ktrpck8lf37p4: acc plus the steps the numbers n · 1000 + 1 to n · 1000 + k take to reach 1.
